about: The shape of a run of values at the size of a word, without axes or a tooltip. The line spans the run's own range, so the figure it belongs to goes beside it.

builds.about: label names a run shown without a figure, as an image with that name. It takes no tab stop.
builds.label: Build time over the last 15 builds, from 4.2 to 3.1 minutes
builds.title: Without a figure

errors.about: color takes a palette's chart color, here the error palette's for errors per hour.
errors.label: Errors per hour
errors.title: Palette

launch.about: area fills under the line with the chart's gradient. The line spans the run's own range, so a fill measures volume only for a run that starts at zero, as a count since launch does.
launch.label: Customers since launch
launch.title: Area

offline.about: A value that is not a finite number leaves a gap in the line, here two readings the sensor missed. A zero in their place would plot a fall that never happened.
offline.label: Server room
offline.title: Missing readings

replay.about: animate reveals the line from its start when the sparkline mounts, and Replay mounts it again. Under reduced motion recharts renders it at once.
replay.label: Customers since launch, from 0 to 1,240
replay.title: Animation

revenue.about: The week's revenue as a stat with the run of daily revenue beside it. The sparkline is hidden from assistive technology, because the stat states the figure.
revenue.label: Revenue this week
revenue.title: Beside a figure

services.about: p95 latency per service with the last 24 hours at the small size in each row. Each run spans its own range, so checkout's rise and search's fall read at a glance.
services.caption: p95 latency per service
services.title: In a table

size.about: Three boxes on the grid, four times as wide as they are tall: 64 by 16 pixels at sm, 96 by 24 at md and 128 by 32 at lg.
size.title: Sizes

stretch.about: stretch fills the width of the container at the size's height, here a room 24rem wide.
stretch.title: Stretch

target.about: baseline={300} renders a dashed line at the 300 ms target, and the range widens to include it.
target.help: Above the 300 ms target at 13:00 and 14:00
target.label: p95 latency
target.title: Baseline

title: Sparkline
